Right Here Right Now Morocco successfully advocated for several SRHR-related recommendations which were put forward by member states to the government of Morocco. 10 Recommendations referred to the revision of the Family Code to ban child marriage, of which 5 Morocco accepted. Furthermore, Morocco accepted the recommendation submitted by Mexico concerning the integration of sexual and reproductive health programmes, the prevention of adolescent pregnancies and access to contraceptive methods into universal health coverage, particularly in rural areas. Morocco rejected the recommendations related to consensual relations, marital rape and same-sex relations. However, Morocco did accept a recommendation to end discrimination and criminalize violence against persons on the basis of their sexual orientation or gender identity.
